name: Promotion of macropinocytosis, ruffling and early endosome progression
rationale: All members positively regulate fluid-phase uptake (pinocytosis, macropinocytosis), the ruffle/podosome protrusions that drive it, or onward early-endosome localization and transport, distinguishing it from the leading-edge motility confusable and the transcytosis/caveolar endocytosis confusables.

name: Mitochondrial import, protein processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover import of proteins, RNA and calcium into mitochondria, mitochondrial protein processing and degradation, and cristae/outer membrane organization, unlike confusables centred on respiratory complex assembly or fission/mitophagy.

name: Protein lipidation and autoprocessing of Hedgehog and Ras
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, C-terminal processing and autoproteolysis exemplified by Hedgehog and RAS maturation, distinguishing it from Wnt/PORCN, geranylgeranylation and GPI-anchor confusables.

core: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
name: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
rationale: All members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides or nitric oxide/nitrosative stress, unlike confusables about oxidative-stress apoptosis regulation, hypoxia/ischemia or ROS detoxification enzymes.

name: Antigen-driven B cell activation, Tfh co-stimulation and memory
rationale: Members cover germinal centre and B-1 B cell differentiation, BCR-driven proliferation, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, memory B cell signatures and B cell modules, which the B cell development confusables lack.

core: Glutamate and GABA uptake and metabolism
name: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter uptake and metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/aspartate and GABA transport, reuptake, synthesis and degradation plus SLC1/SLC17A8 transporter defects, distinguishing it from glycinergic and cholinergic neurotransmission confusables.

name: Hindbrain development and locomotor, reflex and suckling behavior
rationale: Members combine brainstem/pons/hindbrain maturation and Purkinje layer formation with brainstem-driven motor outputs (walking, righting reflex, suckling, respiratory control, motor learning), which the cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia and hindbrain migration confusables lack.

name: CDX- and HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte program
rationale: Two of three members are CDX/HNF4-specified differentiated absorptive enterocyte modules (leukocyte migration is an unexplained outlier), distinguishing it from crypt stem/EPCAM-KLF5 epithelial and bile acid confusables.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: Every member is resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants to a specific TKI, whereas confusables describe oncogenic signaling by EGFR, ERBB2, FGFR, PDGFRA and LTK variants.

name: Glycerophospholipid acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE, PS and PG
rationale: Members are acyl-chain remodeling of phosphatidylcholine, -ethanolamine, -serine and -glycerol, unlike confusables on de novo phospholipid/cardiolipin synthesis, DAG/TAG metabolism or PI remodeling.

name: Nociception, thermoception and itch perception
rationale: Members detect thermal and mechanical noxious stimuli, perceive pain and itch and promote fever and excitability, distinguishing it from K2P channel, resting potential and chemosensory taste/smell confusables.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast development and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members cover RUNX2 control of osteoblast development, direct ossification, cranial suture and trabecular bone formation plus cartilage/tendon morphogenesis, unlike chondrocyte, osteoblast proliferation/Wnt and BMP mesenchymal confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR variants and TKI resistance
rationale: All members are signaling by, TKI binding of, or drug resistance of mutant, amplified or fused KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR kinases, whereas confusables centre on FLT3 inhibitor resistance, PDGFRA/FLT3 fusions or cytokine (EPO/TPO/IL-3) signaling.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly, turnover and EMT control
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) cell-cell adhesion, adherens junction assembly, CDH1 trafficking/degradation/cleavage and EMT regulation, distinguishing it from epithelial polarity/desmosome and tight junction barrier confusables.

name: Enamel and dentin mineralization and tooth eruption
rationale: Members cover dentinogenesis, enamel mineralization and its SLC24A4 defect, tooth eruption and secreted-protein phosphorylation of mineralizing matrix, unlike confusables on phosphate/vitamin D homeostasis, bone mineralization or odontoblast/cementum development.

name: Cerebellar cortex development and voluntary motor control
rationale: Members combine Purkinje, granule and Bergmann glia layer development with proprioception, voluntary movement, locomotion and motor-neuron survival, which the brainstem/respiratory and vocal/striatal confusables lack.

name: GDP-mannose and dolichol-phosphate mannose synthesis with DPM-CDG
rationale: All members concern mannose activation to GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose, including DPM1/2/3 CDG defects, distinguishing it from confusables built on PMM2, MPI, PGM1, DOLK and later-step CDGs.

name: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis, degradation and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members span N-/O-glycan, GPI, glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid synthesis, nucleotide-sugar supply, lysosomal glycan degradation and their CDG/MPS diseases (a few outliers aside), unlike confusables on central sugar metabolism, ECM proteoglycans or Golgi/ER vesicle traffic.

name: Translation-factor and tRNA hypermodification and protein hydroxylation
rationale: Members are specialised residue modifications that support translation elongation (eIF5A hypusine, eEF2 diphthamide, tRNA-Phe wybutosine) plus peptidyl proline/lysine hydroxylation, distinguishing it from polyamine, tRNA aminoacylation, selenocysteine and protein methylation confusables.

core: Spindle orientation in neural progenitor division
name: Spindle orientation in forebrain neural progenitor division
rationale: Members combine astral microtubule/spindle positioning and asymmetric division with forebrain neuroblast division and neural stem cell maintenance, which the centrosome-only and neuroblast-proliferation-only confusables each lack half of.

name: Olfaction and sour taste perception
rationale: Members are perception of odorants and sour taste and chemical taste detection, distinguishing it from olfactory receptor/pheromone, sweet/bitter/umami/salty and acid-sensing channel confusables.

name: Neutral amino acid transmembrane transport
rationale: All members transport neutral amino acids (leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, alanine, glutamine), unlike cationic amino acid, peptide or organic cation/xenobiotic transport confusables.

name: Glycine, threonine and proline metabolism with acyl-glycine conjugation
rationale: Members cover glycine, threonine, proline and glyoxylate synthesis/catabolism and glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids, distinguishing it from aromatic/sulfur amino acid, glutamate and alanine metabolism confusables.

name: Mitochondrial translation and ribosome, tRNA and rRNA maturation
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation to termination and quality control plus mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing and modification, unlike mtDNA replication, mtRNA decay or pseudouridylation confusables.

core: Endocytic entry and early endosome sorting
name: Raft-caveolar and clathrin endocytosis with early endosome sorting
rationale: Members concern raft assembly, caveolin and clathrin cargo uptake, pinocytosis, transcytosis and early-to-late/recycling endosome sorting, distinguishing it from macropinocytosis/ruffling, GLUT4 translocation and receptor recycling/degradation confusables.
